QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Gathering Scattered Memories 4
QuestInfo.0: You agree to gather the scattered memories from the strong Erdas around town. Talk to Chief Legato and hear about the next memories you need to recover.
QuestInfo.1: You agreed to get Chief Legato 5 Joyful Memories from Joyful Erdas.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chief Legato 5 Joyful Memories from Joyful Erdas. The Tree of Memory was restored once all four types of scattered memories were gathered together.

0.0: Next, you must bring me our Joyful Memories. Are you ready to proceed?

yes.0: The Joyful Erdas in the Weathered Land of Joy have taken our Joyful Memories.
yes.1: Please recover the 50 Joyful Memories that hung upon the Tree of Memory.

no.0: You are the only one who can recover our memories from those powerful Erdas.

1.0: You recovered all of the Joyful Memories that once hung upon the Tree of Memory.
1.1: Please, unite the memories... Return them to their places on the tree...

yes.0: It is done. By your hand, the Happy, Raging, Sad, and Joyful Memories have all been returned to their proper place. Thank you.
yes.1: The Tree of Memory has regained its brilliant glow. Now the devastated townspeople will be happy again. Thank you for your help.

item.0: Bring me Joyful Memories from the Joyful Erdas in the Weathered Land of Joy.
